Technique

Findings
Lungs: A 2.4 × 1.8 cm spiculated nodule is identified in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, demonstrating heterogeneous enhancement. No cavitation.

Mediastinum: Mildly enlarged right paratracheal and subcarinal lymph nodes, the largest measuring 14 mm. No pericardial effusion.

Pleura: Trace right pleural effusion. No pneumothorax.
Impression
1. Spiculated 2.4 cm nodule in the right lower lobe — highly suspicious for primary lung malignancy. Tissue diagnosis recommended.
2. Trace right pleural effusion.
3. No evidence of distant metastatic disease within the imaged volume.
